title: Where you come from and live
summary: Use the English meaning and the Japanese context. Type Japanese, preserving small kana and long vowels.

c01.note: から marks the point of origin.

c02.note: に marks the location with 住んでいます.

c04.note: 住んでいます is a polite way to state where one lives.

c05.note: 来ました is read きました.

c07.note: と marks the person or people one lives with.

c08.note: 国名 + 人 gives a nationality; 人 is read じん here.
